candidates.requirement: Initialize the notes obstack before the assembly pass creates sections.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls read_begin, then perform_an_assembly_pass(2, fakeArgv). The pass calls subseg_new; subseg_get allocates section information from notes when that information is absent.
candidates.failure_condition: For a newly created section without segment information, alloc_seginfo uses obstack_alloc on notes, while the entry has bypassed its initialization in main.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry never calls main or another notes initializer. read_begin initializes cond_obstack, not notes. The section creation precedes reading the fuzzer's file, so changing its bytes cannot avoid this route.
